g_eb5a72bbb8c8.title: Opt-in strict parse that rejects unitless numbers in ms

anchorAsk.text: People keep putting bare numbers like "30" in config files, and ms reads that as 30 milliseconds, which is almost always a mistake. Add an opt-in way to make `parse` reject strings that have no unit (return NaN for them). The default behaviour must not change. Tests too.
